ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed Lost") ), ISCHANGED(Stage__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, "Active"), ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, "Pending with Quotation Team"), ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, "Pending for Review"), ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, "Resent to Central Quotation Team") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity cannot be marked as 'Closed Won' or 'Closed Lost' while the Quote is in 'Active,' 'Pending with Quotation Team,' 'Pending for Review,' or 'Resent to Central Quotation Team.
